Interface TempDirDeletionStrategy.DeletionResult

Enclosing interface:
TempDirDeletionStrategy
public static sealed interface TempDirDeletionStrategy.DeletionResult
Represents the result of a TempDirDeletionStrategy.delete(Path, AnnotatedElementContext, ExtensionContext) operation, including any paths that could not be deleted.
Since:
6.1
